# Frozen pre-feature WAL fixtures

These files were captured with the `0.8.2` writer before crash-safe recovery changed
startup publication. They are compatibility inputs and must not be regenerated by
the recovery implementation.

| File | SHA-256 | Expected logical contents |
|---|---|---|
| `kv.wal.dat` | `e48dee8c4a07db010778d08037ac96a6cd16ca5fb323ea40145bd1fa36cb75f2` | `alpha=uno`, `empty=[]`; `beta` absent |
| `set.wal.dat` | `d81d058ae3eabff04e08a8f12cad339e223f05f1fe532c82766b0565611cb653` | `group={red}`; `removed` absent |
| `map.wal.dat` | `4612530c4b7b95ef8cb557c0306b2f11a5598a053b31dffec9f9aedb9477e84e` | `book={2:b2}`, `other={3:c}` |

The histories intentionally include overwrites, deletes, duplicate set appends,
member removals, multiple outer keys, and an empty value.
